items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Lionel asked Joe Glycer (?) said, 'Who do you want to play with.' ... So, that ... I stayed with him, I think, about six years, something like that.

ctx.x: Didn't you join Luis Russell's band after Pops was leading the band?

Yeah, that's when I joined the band after ... '37 we were playing in Savoy and Louis Armstrong came from Chicago, you know, like to sit in. OK, excuse me. So when he finished his date and Louis Armstrong closed the engagement in Savoy, we went down to Saratoga Club Montgomery (?) and Louis Armstrong played one night down there with the Broadcasters (?). (indub.) And, ... we were playing at ... and Louis came to New York to get his own band. He came back with Louis Armstrong's band and Lionel Hampton was getting a…
You mentioned before that you made your first recording with King Oliver's band.
